narration_text: Dave's premium card just came back with a six-hundred-ninety-five-dollar annual fee. Chad says the fix is simple: spend eighty dollars to unlock a twenty-dollar credit. Points Monk has a less glamorous answer. If you wouldn't buy the thing anyway, that credit isn't saving you money. Count only value you'd purchase without the card, subtract the fee you actually pay, and keep the card only when the math still wins.
notes: $695 is an unnamed educational example, not a claim about a currently named product.
